source.quote: Please extract and display the content of page 11 from the local file '/workspace/path_to_local_copy_of_the_book', including the second-to-last paragraph and the endnote.

requirements.requirement: Explicit task requirement: retrieve the Wikipedia access day from the endnote associated with the second-to-last paragraph of page 11 of the book identified by DOI 10.2307/j.ctv9b2xdv. The requested extraction must concern that document and passage.

If you have access to the file or can download it locally, please open the book with DOI 10.2307/j.ctv9b2xdv
